name: IACE Ribbon (miniature medal body)
size_basis: estimated: the body measured in the Vanguard product photograph against the suspension ribbon's width, 172 px taken as 0.6875 in (the miniature suspension ribbon, 11/16 in, CAPR 39-1 11.3 as compose.js MINI_DRAPE): body 0.6915 x 0.8993 in in the photograph. Height follows the body's own aspect. The width is the existing CAP asset's (0.625 in, assets/medals, kept as the brief asks; the photo measures 0.6915 in). The drawing keeps the width and the box; it is built from the photograph's own measured proportions (body width 174.7 px = 0.625 in).
ribbon_attach_note: ribbon_attach is the top centre of the suspension ring (or of the bail where the box cuts the ring away), on the body axis: the body is upright, the photograph's hang angle (-2.2 deg) is removed; compose.js hangs it at the drape's V point

dimensions.ribbon_note: medal body only; the ribbon asset supplies the stripes and devices (ribbon_ref as the previous asset)

match_note: CAP body: the existing asset id and width of assets/medals/medal-iace-ribbon-miniature; ribbon_ref as that asset

ribbon_ref.note: medal body only; the ribbon asset supplies the stripes and devices. ribbon_attach is the top of the suspension ring.

frame.note: body width 0.625 in (the spec width); every length below is inches in the medal frame (origin = body centre, +y down, upright)

measured.hang_angle_note: angle (clockwise, degrees) at which the photographed medal hangs, from the bail axis; measured, removed: the shipped body is upright and ribbon_attach is the top centre of the ring (or of the bail where the box cuts the ring)

lettering.letter_positions: angle and radial extent of each letter, measured from the unwrapped annulus (generator, text.top / text.bottom)

gates.silhouette_iou: >= 0.95 (shipped upright miniature vs the photograph mask resampled into the same upright box)
gates.landmarks: every named feature centroid within 0.02 in of the reference
gates.edge_recall: lit-metal outline recall >= 0.80 within 0.012 in (0.006 in reported)
gates.ink_coverage: lit-metal area of mine / reference between 0.85 and 1.15 (body and named zones): letters and emblem strokes as solid as the reference
gates.ribbon_attach: top centre of the ring (or of the bail where the box cuts the ring) at the box top, x on the body axis

not_measurable: The two forearms are a cuff stripe (one bar with a faint line down its middle, not resolved into two) and a hem bar against the inner circle; on the left the hem bar merges with the inner circle line, so its width is not separable

Continents: the photograph resolves four land masses and the Caribbean tongue; coast detail finer than about 0.01 in (bays, islands) is not resolvable and is simplified to straight coast segments read at 3600 px/in
The top of the globe: a bright dome under the inner circle (drawn as a polar cap) and a small bar and dot (drawn as two islands) cannot be identified, only their size and place are measured

The sea is cast with a mottled texture (lit blotches about 0.01 in across, about 55 percent lit in the lower sea, 35 percent in the upper sea) that is not an engraved object: drawn as the flat ground tone; the lower sea is left out of the gates body test (P.sel)

The right-hand lower band (angle 40 to 140 deg, r 0.212 to 0.289 in) is lit more brightly in the photograph by worn patina, not by an engraved feature: drawn as the flat ground tone and left out of the gates body test (P.sel); the letters there (A T R O L) are drawn from their measured angles and widths but their solidity is gated only in the other sectors. The ring of the photograph is tilted: its visible left and right arcs are fitted (outer edge circle c 0.0144, -0.4881 in, r 0.1399 in)

Finger separations (slits) are about 0.002 in wide and blurred: each of the eight fingers is one modelled bar placed at its measured centre, angle, length and width; thumb and palm creases are not drawn
fidelity.note: Redrawn as clean parametric vector (LIVE13-ART 26, batch B): every element is modelled as the object it is (letters, stars, wreath leaves, banner, aircraft ...) with its proportions measured from the photograph and placed by measurement; flat tones with a lit and a shadow edge; upright. Replaces the traced body (LIVE13-ART 20).

fit_score.note: IoU of the shipped upright miniature against the photograph mask in the same box (lib-b.js)

notes: Designed miniature medal body (LIVE13-ART 26, batch B), upright. Measured from iace-award.jpeg (reference only, never shipped). Hang angle -2.2 deg of the photograph removed.
